meta.title: Tarrant, Dallas, and Collin County Voter Guide
meta.note: Race names, candidate names, and party labels are transcribed from the Texas Secretary of State Ballot Certification Reports for the November 3, 2026 general election in Tarrant County (sources/ballot-certification-2026-11-03.pdf), Dallas County (sources/ballot-certification-dallas-2026-11-03.pdf), and Collin County (sources/ballot-certification-collin-2026-11-03.pdf). Endorsement and donation data has not been collected yet; those arrays are empty for every candidate. Each entry carries a ballotOrder keyed by county name: its 1-based position in that county's certification report, which is the order the races and the candidates within each race appear on that county's printed ballot. A statewide or shared-district race certified by more than one county is a single record carrying a position for each. A race title more than one county uses for different offices - COUNTY JUDGE, DISTRICT CLERK, COUNTY COMMISSIONER PRECINCT 2 - is separate records per county, told apart by the county field.
